properties.project_name: 700 Indiana St -- MBC BioLabs lab/office building (adjacent to Pier 70)
properties.digitized_from: The real DataSF Assessor parcel for blklot 4062007 (700 Indiana St, Dogpatch), taken from DataSF's Assessor parcel data on 2026-09-28. The polygon itself is the real, unmodified Assessor shape.
properties.regulatory_context: SF Planning Case No. 2023-001074ENX. Planning Commission approved the project 2024-06-13 (Motion No. 21576): a 3-story-plus-basement, ~70,650-72,350 gross sq ft lab/office building (sources give slightly different figures) replacing an existing ~15,068 sq ft one-story building, for MBC BioLabs. On 2024-09-24 the Board of Supervisors affirmed the Planning Department's CEQA general plan evaluation exemption, rejecting a neighborhood appeal of it, by 9-1 with Supervisor Walton dissenting (Motion No. M24-089; Board of Supervisors minutes of 2024-09-24, File 240778: 'Ayes: 9' and 'Noes: 1 - Walton'). Potrero View (Nov 2024) reported an 'eight-to-two vote'; the minutes record eight Noes on the separate motions to table and to reverse, which failed. A separate Board of Appeals appeal of the Planning Commission's approval (Appeal No. 24-040, filed 2024-06-28 by the Dogpatch Neighborhood Association and Potrero Boosters) was still to be heard in late October 2024; Potrero View reported on 2025-01-27 that the two groups withdrew it, but the Board of Appeals' own record of the withdrawal was not read. No DataSF building permit found as of 2026-09-28, so construction has apparently not yet started.
properties.notes: Developer: Dewey Land Company (purchased the site 2022 for $15M). Applicant and operator: MBC BioLabs (the project would provide laboratory, office, conference and community rental space for biotechnology startups; no source read names a single end tenant). Architect: MBH Architects.
